method: Temporal windows over observable step_finish events. Pre-product ends before the first completed product write. Middle ends at the step containing the last completed code/test/note write or non-dry-run makemigrations. Remaining steps are verification/close. These windows do not attribute causal cost to a tool or expose private reasoning.
interpretation: The lower-token member of each pair had no durable ODD note; each arm created one note in total. This association is not proof that notes caused the difference or should be prohibited. Test decisions, product fragmentation, post-green changes and grouping also varied. Note-only step totals include prior context and are not removable-cost estimates.
